notes: Initial N-14 8C (filed October 8, 2021) for the reorganization of MYJ into MUJ (the Acquiring Fund). Two classes are exchanged: MYJ common holders receive Acquiring Fund common shares of equal aggregate NAV (cash in lieu of fractions), and MYJ VRDP Holders receive Acquiring Fund VRDP Shares one-for-one; security_class is set to common because this prospectus is delivered to common shareholders, and the VRDP leg is noted here. Conditions come from the 'Amendments and Conditions' summary because the Form of Agreement and Plan of Reorganization (Appendix A) is marked '[TO COME]' in this filing; 'other' covers third-party consents (including the VRDP liquidity provider), an opinion of counsel on corporate and securities matters, and the accuracy of representations and warranties. The expected closing ('sometime during [●]'), the meeting date and the record date are bracketed placeholders, so expected_close, meeting_date and record_date are null. Termination is by mutual board consent or by a board if a condition is unmet; no outside date is stated. One ticker sentence in the filing misnames MUJ as 'BlackRock MuniHoldings Quality Fund, Inc.'; I used the cover-page names. The text file renders cp1252 punctuation as control characters U+0091-U+0097; spans that include them use JSON \u escapes so they parse to the exact characters in the file.
